$$
\int 3(5-3x)^{-3}\,\text{d}x.
$$

Let $u=5-3x.$ Then differentiating with respect to $x$ gives

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=-3\,⟹\,\text{d}x=-\frac{1}{3}\text{d}u.
$$

We now write our integral in terms of $u,$ calculate the integral as normal, and write the final answer in terms of $x$ at the very end:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 3(5-3x)^{-3}\,\text{d}x & =3\int {u}^{-3}\cdot (-\frac{1}{3})\,\text{d}u \\  & =3\cdot (-\frac{1}{3})\int {u}^{-3}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\int {u}^{-3}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{1}{(-2)}{u}^{-2}+C \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(5-3x)^{-2}+C \\  & =\frac{1}{2(5-3x)^{2}}+C\end{aligned}
$$

Let's double-check that our result is correct. If we differentiate the result, then it should come out to the original integrand:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[\frac{1}{2(5-3x)^{2}}+C] & =\frac{1}{2}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[\frac{1}{(5-3x)^{2}}]+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(C) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[(5-3x)^{-2}]+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(C) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot (-2)(5-3x)^{-3}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(5-3x)+0 \\  & =-(5-3x)^{-3}\cdot (-3) \\  & =3(5-3x)^{-3} \\  & =\frac{3}{(5-3x)^{3}}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["cbbfcc56-2097-59e6-8df3-eab502cf4f79"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "1360a76d-bdc7-5f69-b60a-bd2f09ca9f84" :answer/id #uuid "1360a76d-bdc7-5f69-b60a-bd2f09ca9f84" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{1}{(3-x)^{4}}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "269e93ad-dc56-5ae8-9082-a55eb20287dd" :answer/id #uuid "269e93ad-dc56-5ae8-9082-a55eb20287dd" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-\frac{4}{(3-x)^{4}}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "a0336689-0e13-5f83-9272-b3409590e5d2" :answer/id #uuid "a0336689-0e13-5f83-9272-b3409590e5d2" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{2}{(3-x)^{4}}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "40e2a044-06da-5da0-8f33-77eb00e3d1ec" :answer/id #uuid "40e2a044-06da-5da0-8f33-77eb00e3d1ec" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{4}{(3-x)^{4}}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "5b96278e-eb56-5e2c-8b74-597a29b2b2a0" :answer/id #uuid "5b96278e-eb56-5e2c-8b74-597a29b2b2a0" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-\frac{1}{(3-x)^{4}}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "f44b9ca1-9b1d-5e25-9550-150b2f5c324d" :answer-field/id #uuid "f44b9ca1-9b1d-5e25-9550-150b2f5c324d" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["1360a76d-bdc7-5f69-b60a-bd2f09ca9f84" "269e93ad-dc56-5ae8-9082-a55eb20287dd" "a0336689-0e13-5f83-9272-b3409590e5d2" "40e2a044-06da-5da0-8f33-77eb00e3d1ec" "5b96278e-eb56-5e2c-8b74-597a29b2b2a0"] :answer-field/correct "1360a76d-bdc7-5f69-b60a-bd2f09ca9f84" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "beed05dd-1df0-5509-b310-7367b8962226" :question/id #uuid "beed05dd-1df0-5509-b310-7367b8962226" :question/problem "$\int \frac{4}{(3-x)^{5}}\,\text{d}x=$" :question/worked-solution "First, we rewrite the integral as
